title: 从未被点单的菜品
objective: 用左连接和右表主键 NULL 找出没有订单明细的菜品。
statement: 找出从未出现在 order_items 中的菜品，依次输出 dish_id、dish_name；每道符合条件的菜一行。如果每道菜都出现在至少一条明细中，返回零行。
knowledge: dishes 放在 LEFT JOIN 左侧，先保留每道菜；order_items.dish_id 指向 dishes.id。INNER JOIN 会在配对阶段直接删掉从未被点过的菜。
一份菜可出现在多条订单明细里，连接后会重复展开；这不表示菜品记录重复。本题只筛完全没有配对的菜。
未配对时右表主键 oi.id 被补为 SQL NULL，所以用 WHERE oi.id IS NULL 筛出。主键本身非 NULL；若把条件用于 ON，会改变哪些明细能配对，不能替代连接后的未匹配判断。
starterSql: -- 找出从未出现在订单明细中的菜品。

hints.text: 保留每道菜及其可能的所有明细配对，再留下没有任何配对的菜。
LEFT JOIN 按 oi.dish_id = d.id 配对，连接后用 WHERE oi.id IS NULL 找未匹配项。
SELECT d.id AS dish_id, d.name AS dish_name FROM dishes AS d LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT d.id AS dish_id, d.name AS dish_name FROM dishes AS d LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.dish_id = d.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 左连接保留全部菜品，并按 dish_id 寻找明细。未匹配行的 oi.id 为 SQL NULL；连接后筛选它即可找出从未出现在任何明细中的菜。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT d.id AS dish_id, d.name AS dish_name FROM dishes AS d JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.dish_id = d.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;
SELECT d.id AS dish_id, d.name AS dish_name FROM dishes AS d LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.dish_id = d.id AND oi.id IS NULL;
SELECT d.id AS dish_id, d.name AS dish_name FROM dishes AS d LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.dish_id = d.id;
